column1: # Ollama 0.40.16's inputs, each pinned by size and SHA-256 (read on 2026-11-21).
# The release publishes no signature for its Linux bundles: the size and the SHA-256 here were checked against the release's own
# sha256sum.txt and GitHub's asset digest, which come from the same origin as the files. The tag's source is pinned by its tarball's
# SHA-256, the commit its pax header names and the git tree id of its files.
# AMD's ROCm 7.2.1 licences: the bundle carries AMD's libraries without their texts; they come from AMD's repositories at the tag rocm-7.2.1
